tagline: Reading the crow. Behavior, calls, and intelligence decoded episode by episode, with every Short from the channel.

guides.title: What This Channel Decodes
guides.body: Crows are among the smartest animals on earth, and most people walk past them every day without reading a thing. This channel breaks down crow behavior, calls, memory, and problem solving, one observation at a time, so you start seeing what they are actually doing.

guides.title: Watch In Order
guides.body: The episodes build on each other: start with the earliest Video and work forward, then catch the Shorts for single behaviors in a minute or less. Search by a behavior, like gift or alarm, to jump straight to the episodes about it.

guides.title: How To Use This App
guides.body: Every video on the channel is listed here, newest first. Search by a word in the title. Tap any video to watch it on YouTube, and tap the star to save a favorite. The list refreshes itself from the channel feed when you open the app, so new videos appear here with no app update.
